item.title: Punxsutawney Phil sees his shadow, forecasting 6 more weeks of winter
item.description: Punxsutawney Phil, the world-famous weather-predicting groundhog, has once again seen his shadow, signaling six more weeks of winter. The announcement was made during the annual Groundhog Day celebration at Gobbler’s Knob in Punxsutawney, Pennsylvania, where thousands of attendees braved the cold to witness the beloved tradition.
